{{Quote|Crutag's mean, you know. He killed little Hewi just 'cos he didn't know where the ship was.|Slimego|<ref name="DoE" />}}
'''Hewi''' was a small [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who worked for [[Taloron Hunters|Taloron Hunter]] [[Crutag]], whose gang pursued a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] to the jungle world of [[Trinta]]. Whilst on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Crutag was angered when his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Scent of Fear]]'', inexplicably disappeared. Crutag took out his anger on hapless Hewi, punching him in the head, his neck snapping when he hit the ground.<ref name="DoE" />
